author: Viva La Dirt League
description:
Director Alan steals a rare moment amid the chaos of a demanding film set, reflecting on how freely he gives himself to others - while wondering if he’s left anything for himself. Made with the Support of NZ on Air.

If you're struggling with your mental health, please seek help. Here are some worldwide resources that could help:
